errors.evidence: The figure is a horizontal bar chart, not a line chart.
The horizontal axis represents the productivity values (revenue per employee), while the vertical axis lists the economic activities. The description swaps them.
The categories on the y-axis are not sorted in alphabetical order.

errors.text_span: измерена в лева на заето лице (лв/чов.)
errors.evidence: The chart's title specifies the unit as 'хил.лв./заето лице', which means 'thousands of BGN per employee', not 'BGN per employee'. This is an error of a factor of 1000.
The numerical labels on the horizontal axis are marked at intervals of 100 (i.e., 0, 100, 200), not 100,000. The unit 'thousands of BGN' applies to these numbers.
There is no category with this name in the chart. The value 172.547 corresponds to the category 'ОПЕРАЦИИ С НЕДВИЖИМИ ИМОТИ' (Real estate operations).
The value 172.547 is not the highest value in the chart. The highest value is 569.880.

errors.text_span: Стените са подредени по низходящ ред
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in descending order of value. Their order appears to be arbitrary.

The description fails to mention that the bar for 'ДОБИВНА ПРОМИШЛЕНОСТ' (Mining industry) is highlighted in red, which is a key visual feature of the chart intended to draw attention to this specific category.
The word 'Стените' (walls) is an unconventional and unclear term for the bars in a bar chart. 'Стълбове' or 'ленти' would be more appropriate.
